mapper.sql: id, task_id, project_id, ai_level, effective_level, matched_rule_id, status, question, options, recommendation, reversible, blast_radius, resolved_by, resolved_choice, resolution_note, raised_at, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM decision WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM decision WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status != 'PENDING' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO decision (task_id, project_id, ai_level, effective_level, matched_rule_id, status, question, options, recommendation, reversible, blast_radius, resolved_by, resolved_choice, resolution_note, raised_at, resolved_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskId}, #{projectId}, #{aiLevel}, #{effectiveLevel}, #{matchedRuleId}, #{status}, #{question}, #{options}, #{recommendation}, #{reversible}, #{blastRadius}, #{resolvedBy}, #{resolvedChoice}, #{resolutionNote}, #{raisedAt}, #{resolvedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE decision SET status = #{status}, resolved_by = #{resolvedBy}, resolved_choice = #{resolvedChoice}, resolution_note = #{resolutionNote}, resolved_at = #{resolvedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
